dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two parallel, high-contrast, horizontal white bands are visible across the lower wing coverts; the upper band appears thinner and more fragmented, while the lower band is thicker and more continuous.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent, sharp-edged white fringes are visible along the edges of the tertials and inner secondary flight feathers, creating a high-contrast geometric outline against the darker gray base.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; the gray plumage transitions smoothly from the top of the head to the mantle without a visible color or boundary transition.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive pattern of large, oval white spots is visible on the tail feathers (rectrices), organized into two roughly horizontal tiers.
